title: ENARA Experiment 4 - pre-registration (current ENARA vs improved ENARA vs plain AI tutor)
note: AI-simulated students only; not evidence about real learners. Locked (SHA-256 recorded) before the pilot. The main stage may only start after the pilot's variance estimate fixes N by the rule below.
design: Matched triplets: each unit (student, outcome, replication) is run under A, B and C with identical hidden learner state and per-item behaviour flags (seeded from student, outcome and replication only). One outcome per area per student-replication. Pre-test, immediate post-test, transfer, simulated delayed retention (1/7/30 days), 4 items per stage, 3 answer samples per item with majority vote.

conditions.A: current ENARA, flag off (code state of Experiment 3; commit 070458d plus default-off research hooks)
conditions.C: plain AI tutor (same prompt and model as Experiment 3)

holdout.rule: Primary analysis uses the 16 hold-out outcomes only; the pilot uses the 32 development outcomes only; all-48 analysis is secondary.
holdout.disclosure: The roadmap was written after reading transcripts of 8 outcomes (FN-01, GR-07, WR-05, WR-04, GR-01, RD-02, FN-07, RD-04), which are excluded from the hold-out. The author also saw per-outcome aggregate A-vs-C scores for all 48 outcomes from Experiment 3; the hold-out guards against transcript-level tuning, not against that aggregate knowledge.

primaryOutcome: Learning gain (post minus pre proportion correct on independent deterministic assessments).
secondaryOutcomes: recap rate in last tutor turn
share of sessions with 3+ consecutive same-shape hints
nonInferiority: B not worse than A on delayed retention by more than 0.03
sampleSizeRule: N_triplets = max(150, ceil(1.2 * 9.505 * sigma2_d / 0.08^2)) with sigma2_d the larger of the pilot variances of the per-triplet gain difference for B-A and B-C; capped at the owner-approved budget; pilot data are not pooled into the main analysis. If the rule exceeds the cap the study stops and reports.
inference: Per-triplet differences; two-way (student x outcome) cluster bootstrap 95% CI; sign-flip permutation test on per-student mean differences; Holm-Bonferroni over the two confirmatory contrasts (alpha 0.025 each); Benjamini-Hochberg over exploratory contrasts; paired d_z with Hedges correction.
decisionRules: B is better than A (or C) only if the Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and the 95% CI excludes 0, on the hold-out set. If B is not better than A on the hold-out set the P0 changes are not recommended. Failed or incomplete blocks stay in the data; unfavourable results are reported in full.
regressionChecks: Existing research and backend suites pass; scripted behaviour regression set (confident wrong belief, answer request, Arabic input, off-topic, leakage bait) run on A and B before the main stage; B must not exceed A on answer leakage, Arabic replies or concession.
limits: Simulation only; matched design removes variance a classroom cannot; process metrics are text-pattern heuristics; no mixed-effects model (library unavailable).
